Sara W: hey team, passing the late-weekend bridge to whoever picks this up. I'm primary until 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Quick summary: earlier today we paged for elevated 95p latency on the inference cluster (nv-3) due to a KV-cache miss storm after a deploy. Customer impact was degraded tail latency for a subset of low-qps customers behind the small-model route. Mitigation applied: rolled traffic to fallback model v1.3, evicted problematic cache keys, and enabled autoscale-burst for the pool. :white_check_mark:

Sara W: important links/runbooks below — store them in your quick toolbar. If you get a pager, follow the checklist in order. No fluff.
- Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback
- Autoscale/Pool ops: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/autoscale-pools
- Rollback guide: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-artifacts

Tom K: thanks, Sara. leaving a couple quick notes from the incident:
- Root cause likely a bad prefix eviction that caused high cache churn.
- Watch error-rate on model-router (route: small-model) and latency p95/p99.
- If autoscale doesn't bring pods up within 90s, we should do a manual spawn: `kubectl scale deploy/rw-infer-nv3 --replicas=6`

Priya S: adding quick commands I'll use if I get the page: 
```
# check pool health
curl -sS https://infra-api.redwood/pools/nv-3/health | jq .
# check redis hits/misses
redis-cli -h redis-kv primary INFO stats | egrep "keyspace_hits|keyspace_misses"
# force evict prefix
python tools/evict_prefix.py --prefix "user-prefetch-" --env prod
```

Marc L: if rollback needed:
- Immediately redirect traffic to model v1.2 (canary safe) using router CLI: `rw-router set-route small-model --model v1.2 --weight 100`
- Confirm no errors in traces: Datadog -> service:rw-router -> traces with error>0
- Postmortem note: take a heap profile of the model servers before scaling down.

Jordan B: coverage note — backup secondary tonight is Li C until 02:00 UTC. I'm available on-call for escalation until 01:00 UTC. If both of us are offline, use the escalation matrix in the runbook (page: eng-sre on-call). :rotating_light:

Li C: ack. two gap items I noticed:
1) Runbook link for the KV evict tool sometimes 403s if you're not on VPN; leave a note if you run it so we can revert permissions.
2) The autoscaler sometimes bottoms out below 3 replicas for low CPU; consider temporary min=3 for nv-3 in the pool config.

incident-bot: Incident 2038499800: pager triggered (route: small-model) severity: P2. Auto-ack by Sara W. See incident timeline: https://incidents.redwood/2038499800

Sara W: on-call handoff checklist (TL;DR):
1) Acknowledge pagers within 2m. Ping primary or secondary in thread.
2) Run `infra-api` pool health check, then check redis hit/miss ratio.
3) If p99 > 2.5s and error-rate > 1%, route to fallback model and file a page.
4) If pods failing to spawn, run manual `kubectl scale` and open an infra ticket.
5) Add a short note to the incident timeline with timestamps and actions.

Priya S: a couple of quick remedies that have worked in the past: evicting the hot prefix, increasing client-side retry backoff, and bumping cache ttl to 10s for the burst window. Use these sparingly and document.

Tom K: extra quick cheat sheet for rollbacks (copy to your clipboard):
```
# switch router
rw-router set-route small-model --model v1.2 --weight 100
# verify
rw-router get-route small-model
# if ok, deprovision the broken artifact
artifactctl deprovision --id arn:rw:model:v1.3 --env prod
```

Marc L: if customer impact is visible (support tickets / big customers complaining) escalate to on-call SRE paged via sales-ops and loop in CS. Use the incident severity matrix in the postmortem runbook to decide P1 vs P2.

Jordan B: leaving this in Li's hands for the early night. Li — if you get a pager, follow Sara's checklist and ping me if you need an extra set of hands. Otherwise I'll jump in on the next rotation. :thumbsup:

Li C: got it. I'll update the pool min replicas and leave a note in the runbook about the VPN permission quirk. Also I'll add a short snippet to the runbook with the exact `redis-cli` commands we used.

Sara W: thanks all — logging out for a bit but I'll monitor DMs. If anything spikes, escalate to P1 as per the runbook. Closing the handoff here, ping this thread to raise attention. :pray:
